scope: All retained reduction records receive a formulation/dependency diagnosis, not a completed proof attempt or full campaign verdict.

families.mathematical_target: Every empty reduction fiber returns the actual initializer; project tuple components only after folding the whole reducer state.
declared_premises: Pure ordered reducer with explicit whole-state initializer; empty input fiber or no output coordinates.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Window sample geometry must establish the empty contribution list or empty output, not just an empty original input.
Tuple-of-tensors versus tensor-of-whole-state packing and window initializer/padding semantics.

families.mathematical_target: Equal-count Reduce is an equal-count row-major reshape, including component projections.
declared_premises: Whole-state reducer initializer is a left identity; bounded recursive keep/reduce axis plan; same input/output element count.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Mathematical tuple packaging and all admitted scalar/reducer profiles; physical representation is a separate observation partition.

families.mathematical_target: A constant nonempty reduction fiber equals op(value, initializer).
declared_premises: Strictly positive fiber count; Boolean and/or or linear-order min/max, with the actual initializer retained.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Zero reduced extent is a separate branch; floating min/max NaN and signed-zero observations do not inherit LinearOrder.
Scalar broadcast coordinate adapter and any finite-width bitwise profile not instantiated here.

families.mathematical_target: Split broadcast axes into mapped base axes and replicated axes; reduce base fibers and count repetitions of each value.
declared_premises: Injective bounded broadcast axis map and compatible extents; derived output-axis renumbering; exact additive monoid with one initializer for repeated addition.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Derive broadcast/reduction fiber factorization and multiplicities from the bounded axis maps.
Initializer placement across nested fibers; rounded count conversion and accumulation observation.

families.mathematical_target: Reducing contiguous concatenated fibers equals the ordered combination of per-block reductions.
declared_premises: Exact AddMonoid with neutral zero initializer; preserve original block and element order.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Bounded Concat axis/output-fiber adapter; non-reduced concatenation axes require a distinct output construction.
Arbitrary reducer monoid laws, nonneutral initializers and rounded/nonassociative profiles.

families.mathematical_target: Move selected batch reductions into contraction coordinates, or factor independent operand reductions and retain the remaining output reduction.
declared_premises: Explicit disjoint batch/free/contract axes and bounded shape equalities; exact semiring multiplication/addition with zero initializers.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Derive each Dot dimension-number transformation and residual output renumbering; delegated target must be a precise mathematical expression.
Floating accumulation/reassociation, conversion and precision observations; result shape and empty dimensions.

families.mathematical_target: Compose two axis plans and compare nested fibers with the combined axis plan, including their actual initializer multiplicities.
declared_premises: Exact associative addition with neutral zero; derived partition of retained and twice-reduced axes.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: General partial outer-axis plan composition is not proved by the all-remaining-axes sum theorem.
Nonzero initializers and nonassociative reducers require an alternate contract or validated refutation.

families.mathematical_target: Zero-initialized sum of pointwise negatives equals pointwise negative of the sum.
declared_premises: Exact AddCommGroup; zero initializer; existing recursive axis plan.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Rounded finite-format negation/addition, signed zero, NaN policy and permitted reduction orders; no group structure is supplied for IEEE addition.

families.mathematical_target: An equal-count reshape that preserves the designated output or reduced blocks induces a per-output reduction-fiber equivalence.
declared_premises: Equal element counts; explicit output-coordinate bijection and derived reduced-block partition; exact commutative additive monoid for reordering.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Derive the bounded per-output fiber equivalence from block boundaries rather than assume the desired equation.
Ordered versus reassociated fibers and scalar/representation partitions.

families.mathematical_target: Arg-extremum value projection agrees with scalar extremum reduction; a constant nonempty fiber selects index zero only under a declared tie/initializer policy.
declared_premises: Bounded index domain; explicit value/index pair comparison, tie-breaking and initial pair; representable zero and nonempty fibers for the constant branch.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Define coupled arg-extremum reducer and derive value projection and index selection, including empty fibers.
Finite-width index representability, NaNs, signed zero and mathematical tie-breaking policy; reuse needs the same declared value observation.

families.mathematical_target: A one-component tuple wrapper transports the whole reducer state and initializer through an explicit singleton-tuple isomorphism.
declared_premises: Pure reducer; same contribution order and conjugated whole-state operation; explicit initializer mapping.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Instantiate and prove the singleton-tuple isomorphism and reducer conjugacy; window version still needs its sample geometry.

families.mathematical_target: Permute input axes and reduce the mapped axes; derive the surviving output-axis permutation or prove it is identity.
declared_premises: Extent-preserving axis permutation with inverse; exact commutative addition if reduced-axis order changes.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Derive the kept/reduced permutation restrictions and output renumbering; do not supply the target equality as a premise.
Ordered numerical observations when the permutation changes contribution order.

families.mathematical_target: A cumulative window over a uniform value contains output_position+1 valid samples; exact additive result is that count times the value.
declared_premises: Derived prefix-window sampling/count; zero additive initializer; explicit count-conversion width and scalar conversion semantics.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Define window geometry and prove the valid-sample count, including low/high bounds and empty dimensions.
Count overflow and conversion-before/after-multiplication; rounded literal conversion and cumulative addition are not replaced by a real-number equation.

families.mathematical_target: A full-span window enumerates exactly the designated Reduce fiber after an output reshape.
declared_premises: Derived full-span geometry, dilation/stride/padding conditions; explicit sample order or exact commutative reducer.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Define bounded window sampler and derive its equivalence with the reduction plan, including padding samples and init multiplicity.
Variadic reducer, output reshape and numerical order profiles.

families.mathematical_target: A padded/broadcast window is replaced by a sequence of bounded broadcasts only after deriving all surviving sample coordinates and initializer effects.
declared_premises: Explicit input padding/broadcast/window composition and scalar conversion placement.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: No typed window/pad/broadcast-sequence composition theorem exists yet; retained helper wording is not an operator definition.
Derive occupied samples, zero/negative extents, initializer contribution law and conversion behavior.

families.mathematical_target: Compose explicit Pad coordinates into window low/high padding and base dilation while preserving each observed contribution.
declared_premises: Bounded signed-padding/interior-padding maps; same whole-state initializer, invalid-sample policy and contribution order.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Derive composed signed geometry and output extent; show equality of valid/invalid sample sequences.
Conversion of explicit pad values versus implicit initializer padding; scalar domain and overflow profiles.

families.mathematical_target: A scalar/unit window produces op(initial, input); elimination additionally requires that actual initializer to be a whole-state left identity.
declared_premises: Derived singleton valid sample and scalar output correspondence; explicit left-identity law if returning the original input.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Define scalar window and tuple packing, prove sample count and initializer law for each retained reducer profile.

families.mathematical_target: A unit window becomes pointwise op(initial, input), restricted by crop coordinates and extended by padding where needed.
declared_premises: Derived crop/pad coordinate maps and output extents; commutation if replacement flips operand order; op(initial,initial)=initial for implicit/explicit padding agreement.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: No typed unit-window/crop/pad equivalence is proved; distinguish invalid sample from a sample of the initializer.
Linear-order extrema versus exceptional floating min/max; additive initializer, signed-zero and rounded observations.

families.mathematical_target: When cropping removes every valid input sample, every remaining output is the declared padding/initializer observation.
declared_premises: Derived absence of valid samples; exact invalid-sample semantics and op(initial,initial)=initial if padding contributes a value.
remaining_mathematical_partitions: Prove all-samples-invalid condition from signed crop bounds and valid output geometry.
Initializer/padding algebra and scalar numerical observation; empty output equality is a separate vacuous branch.
